en.title: Contiguous Prefix-Set Mask of a Permutation
en.description:
For each k, given a permutation of 1..n, determine whether some contiguous subarray has a value set of exactly {1..k}, and output the results in order as an n-character 01 string.

This site's standard input/output is stated explicitly; ranges not given by the source problem are marked as this site's conventions.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains a permutation of 1..n. The source gives no numeric upper bound; this site's range is 1≤n≤100000.
en.output: Output a 01 string of length n, where the k-th character indicates whether some contiguous subarray has value set {1..k}.
en.explanation: Example 1: the positions are contiguous for k equal to 1, 2, and 4, so the output is 1101. Example 2: they are contiguous for k equal to 1, 2, 3, and 5, so the output is 11101. Example 3: the only element forms the set {1} by itself, so the output is 1.
hints: Find the position of each value, then add 1..k one at a time while maintaining the leftmost and rightmost positions; the values are contiguous exactly when the span between these two positions is k.
